purpose: Paste a published Merkle-sum-tree root (hash + sum) and an inclusion proof for one leaf; verifies membership AND local balance-sum-chain consistency entirely offline, client-side. Independently recomputes both the hash chain and the sum chain from the leaf to the root over the pasted proof path -- never trusting the pasted root as an oracle for itself -- and rejects any negative balance or any balance/sum exceeding a declared MAX_BALANCE domain bound anywhere in the path, closing the Maxwell eprint 2022/043 'broken MST' negative-balance-cancellation hazard the same way Summa's own circuit does with a RangeCheckChip, applied here at the application layer instead of inside a ZK circuit. Verify-only: reports leaf inclusion and local range-consistency, never a solvency or reserve-sufficiency claim.
